_comment: Fixture account for the object inventory. Covers EVERY device kind the adapter
supports, not just the maintainer's own hardware (feedback_user_hardware_ist_sample):
a LAN light with segments, a cloud-only light without a local interface (H6199,
verbatim), a captured outdoor light with scenes/DIY/snapshots (H61A8, verbatim), a
thermometer, a gateway-backed battery sensor plus its gateway, a heater, a
humidifier, a fan, an air purifier, a kettle, an ice maker, an aroma diffuser,
a socket, a button and an app device group.
Provenance: a device with `_source` is a WHOLE Govee list entry copied verbatim from
that capture (only the device id is the fixture's). A device without `_source` is a
hand-picked subset of real capability blocks — its shape per capability is Govee's,
its capability SET is not (audit 2026-09-11). Replace it by the verbatim entry as soon
Three verbatim entries were added on 2026-09-12 (audit): H1310 (ceiling-fan light with
main/background light, fan and airflow toggles), H66A1 (movie mode) and H607C (pillar and
base light) — nine capability instances that real captures show and no fixture device had,
so no gate had ever judged their datapoints.
